name: Anker Nano Power Bank (10K, 30W, built-in USB-C cable)
caption:
#ad As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

Never forget your charging cable again. 🔌

The Anker Nano has a 10,000mAh battery with a built-in USB-C cable and 30W fast charging. It also has a USB-C port and a USB-A port for a second device.

Anker says it can charge an iPhone 14 to 50% in about 30 minutes.

Tip: tuck the cable along the body before you toss it in your bag.
